nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_price_update_share_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both use exact equality of adjacent closing levels.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Update share counts each changed transition equally and reads no high or low. Campaign100 allocates continuous destination range mass to unchanged transitions; moving fixed range mass between equality classes changes Campaign100 while leaving the update count unchanged.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_zero_return_amount_intensity_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both condition on exact unchanged-close transitions.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor compares mean destination CNY amount on zero returns with the ordinary mean and explicitly controls event count. Campaign100 reads no amount, forms no conditional mean, and measures the fraction of high-low exploration mass that failed to alter the closing level.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_intrabar_body_range_efficiency_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both distinguish durable price displacement from intrabar high-low exploration.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Body efficiency uses each bar's same-bar absolute open-close body and all 240 ranges. Campaign100 reads no open and classifies destination range only by exact equality between consecutive closes over 238 within-half transitions.

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_close_transition_range_quadratic_efficiency_238p
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: Both align adjacent close transitions with destination high-low ranges on the same 238 support.
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign093 continuously compares squared close-transition variation with squared range variation. Campaign100 discards every nonzero return magnitude, uses linear range mass only, and applies one exact unchanged-versus-changed state. A nonzero return-magnitude change affects Campaign093 but not Campaign100 when its equality class and range are fixed.
